rows.en: Tend to your wounds. I will defeat you before long.
Until then, our duel is on hold.
Understood. The next time we fight, I'll face you with everything I've got, too.
He won't fight dirty... Couldn't there still be some justice left in his heart?
Not pullin' any dirty tricks, huh? Gotta say, I think a bit better of the guy now.
He won't fight dirty... Doesn't that mean there's still some justice left in his heart?

He wants a real, honest duel, huh? I think a little better of him now.
He won't fight dirty... Doesn't that mean there's still some justice left in his heart?
He won't fight dirty... Doesn't that mean there's still some justice left in his heart?
He won't fight dirty... Doesn't that mean there's still some justice left in his heart?
He won't fight dirty... Doesn't that mean there's still some justice left in his heart?
That guy... That guy has no heart like that left in him!
He didn't spare us. He just doesn't care about any life but mine.
I'll be looking forward to it, Black Sun.
Just like the Crisis Empire, he's an enemy I have to defeat, no matter what!
Shadow Moon, risen from the depths of hell.
Taking up his challenge, Black RX burned with fighting spirit.
And the Crisis Empire, too, is sure to strike again with some new strategy.
Don't lose! Kamen Rider Black RX!
Black RX must be in the party to progress this quest.
Word is a martial arts tournament is being held at the Ultra Cube's Colosseum. Investigate at once.
In the Colosseum, kaiju were fighting each other.
And now Bemular can do nothing but defend against Gomora's fierce attacks!
Ohh, Bemular is down!! Gomora wins without giving it a single chance to strike back!!
Amid a storm of roars, the match came to an end.

notes.note: Quest017.bla (QuestEventMess017) maps MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (verified: +2 ??? -> row 3, +68/+69 Shadow Moon -> 69/70, +71 RX -> 72, +118 Shadow Moon -> 119, OkWin +128/+130 -> 129/131). The script has no party-variant indexing at all (RX required, no pt_ variable), so the 14-row blocks 55-68, 73-86, 88-101, 103-116 and rows 87, 102, 117, 118, 120, 124 are never played: a cut version where the whole party reacts. Voiced from wording; identical Japanese kept identical. 'Ngh! He's strong!' should match quest_017 rows 55-57.

Played: Shadow Moon (CHARA_NAME 271) 69/70 and 119; RX (CHARA_NAME 2) 72. Played order is 72 -> 119, so Shadow Moon's 'looking forward to it' answers RX's promise to fight all-out. 'Shoubu wa azuketa' = the fight is left unsettled until then.
Unreferenced block (14 rows = leader list minus RX). Party members, plural 'us' (ore-tachi). Subject 'He' restored (Shadow Moon).
Unreferenced; speaker inferred as RX (answers the party, no variant block).

Unreferenced 14-slot block; slot order not recoverable from Quest017.bla. 88 polite (desu ka: OOO/Mebius-type), 89 rough (shinee: Momotaros/Zero-type), 92 casual -ze, 97 'wants a serious duel' (God Gundam/Zero-type) given their own English; the other ten share one line.
Unreferenced; RX (contradicts the party; 117/118/120 continue his reply). 'Black Sun' (119) is Shadow Moon's name for RX, the franchise's established English; not in glossary.
'Tasuketa' read as 'spared us' (Shadow Moon left them alive); RX says it was only because he cares about no life but RX's.

Narration 122/123/125 played (+121/+122/+124); 124 (+123) is skipped by the script but is narration of the same epilogue. TV-narrator style kept. 122 is a noun-phrase line in the source; kept as a fragment.
Quest title from QuestMess 0.18 'The Shadow Prince'; standard completion format.
OkWin (+130), same format as earlier 'must be in the party' rows.
Quest description (QuestMess 0.69 is the matching longer copy; this quest is QuestMess 0.19 'Money Dopant's Challenge'). Compressed to fit 2 lines; 'shikyuu' kept as 'at once'.

Quest018.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (rows 2-6 empty; verified: +34 Money Dopant -> row 35 in quest_019, +19+14 leader block end -> 34). Played here: +15 crowd roar -> row 16 (with applause SE), then +6 narration -> row 7. Rows 8-15 and 17 are unreferenced: a cut opening bout with an announcer. 18 in quest_019 repeats row 7's Japanese and should match it.
Unreferenced fight: Gomora (attacker per row 10) 8/11/13, Bemular (defending, then down) 9/12/14. New roars, not in the glossary roar list; Gomora's established roars are for different Japanese.
Crowd roar in double brackets in the source; same English as the identical Japanese elsewhere (TM).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest017.bla and Quest018.bla (both TextIdOffset+N = row N+1). Played: Quest017 Shadow Moon 69/70/119, RX 72, narration 122/123/125, OkWins 129/131; Quest018 crowd 16, narration 7. Unreferenced (voiced from wording, slot order unverifiable): Quest017 leader blocks 58-68, 73-86, 88-101, 103-116 and RX lines 87/102/117/118/120, narration 124; Quest018 cut opening bout 8-15, 17 (Gomora vs Bemular, announcer). Not in glossary: 'Black Sun' (Shadow Moon's name for RX).
